items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: So I joined Clarence Johnson, and he had a little thing... And that's where I met Pugh.

ctx.x: And it was a populous(?) city.

Yeah, and it was a Twin City. It was a big town. It was the Twin Cities. And they had a lot of music going there, and you could...and I just... I think Eddie Barefield played with Clarence Johnson. I got to talking with Eddie one day, boy, and...
Remember a fellow named Jack Oglesby? Remember him?
